product.name: Cartage Daily Car Sharing Insurance
product.description: A daily insurance product that complements the owner's auto insurance to cover risks when a vehicle is lent to another driver, including young drivers, for 5€ per day.

product.name: Cartage Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that enables users to subscribe quickly to Cartage insurance, manage car sharing history, perform vehicle condition reports, and generate car sharing contracts.
